title: Testing and Explanation

learning_objectives: Explain artist selection, cleaning, visualization, and Audio DNA in plain language and connect it to tests/test_clean_dataset.py; tests/test_cosine_similarity.py; tests/test_artist_selection.py.
Trace one input through the testing and explanation stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: artist selection, cleaning, visualization, and Audio DNA
practical_outcomes: Trace the testing and explanation stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for artist selection, cleaning, visualization, and Audio DNA.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
